edibles.heading: Edibles
paragraphs: O'Connor Smoke Cannabis is at 132 O'Connor Drive, Unit B in East York, a practical stop for people coming from the Danforth, Woodbine, and Don Mills sides of the neighbourhood. The store is open daily from 10:00 AM to 2:30 AM. This page is the edible section for that O'Connor Drive counter.

Edibles are cannabis products you eat or drink from a sealed pack. You compare flavour, format, pack size, and the milligram information on the label. That is a different decision from choosing dried flower or a vape. Use the live edible menu first, then look at the same names in the store.

Posted prices can change. A pack on yesterday’s list may not be on the shelf during your visit. If you are coming from the Danforth or Don Mills specifically for one edible, call 647-924-1664 before you set out.
Walk in at Unit B during posted hours. No appointment is needed. Bring government-issued photo ID. You must be 19 or older. Staff can help you read pack details against current stock on the counter.
If you are coming after the Danforth dinner hour, check the clock against 2:30 AM closing. The edible menu is still only a planning list until you are at Unit B and the pack is on the counter.
O'Connor Drive in East York is the address. Come in while the store is open.

vape-disposables.heading: THC Vapes
paragraphs: O'Connor Smoke Cannabis is the East York shop at 132 O'Connor Dr, Unit B, used by people moving between the Danforth, Woodbine, and Don Mills. Hours run daily from 10:00 AM to 2:30 AM. THC vapes are the vapour-product listings on this menu.

A THC vape is a sealed cannabis vapour item. Listings show brand, listed potency, and pack details. Hardware styles vary with what is posted that day. Check the live menu for current formats instead of assuming a particular style will be waiting. If the live menu does not show a format, do not plan the trip around it.
Posted prices can change. Call 647-924-1664 if one vape listing is the reason you are heading to O'Connor Drive. Mention Unit B so the question stays with this East York counter.
Walk in at Unit B during open hours. Bring valid photo ID. Adults 19+ only. Ask for the vape section and compare the labelled products in person.

Hours matter on this street. The store is not a 24-hour counter. If you are leaving Woodbine or Don Mills late, give yourself time to arrive before 2:30 AM and still read the labels without rushing. After 2:30 AM the door is closed until 10:00 AM.
East York is the neighbourhood. O'Connor Drive, Unit B, is the door.
Review the current menu once more before leaving Woodbine.

concentrates.heading: Concentrates
paragraphs: O'Connor Smoke Cannabis is at 132 O'Connor Drive, Unit B in East York, open daily from 10:00 AM to 2:30 AM for adults coming from the Danforth, Woodbine, and Don Mills. Concentrates are the extract products sold at this counter.

Concentrates are packaged cannabis extracts. Each listing typically includes the product name, extract type, listed potency, and weight. That is a different category from flower tiers and from edible packs. Start with the live concentrate menu, then confirm the same names in the store. Keep flower and extracts on separate lists so the visit stays clear.

Posted prices can change. Do not plan a trip around an old list. Call 647-924-1664 if you need a particular extract checked before you come in. Hours close at 2:30 AM, so leave time to read labels after you arrive.
Walk in at Unit B while the store is open. No appointment. Bring ID. You must be 19 or older. Staff can show the concentrate section and help you read current labels.

If you are comparing extracts, stay with the O'Connor Smoke listings. A name from another East York or Danforth shop is not a hold at Unit B. Ask staff to put the labelled pack next to the live-menu line.
Use O'Connor Drive in East York as the landmark.
Refresh the concentrate page before travelling from Danforth or Don Mills.

vapes.heading: Nic Vapes
paragraphs: O'Connor Smoke Cannabis is at 132 O'Connor Drive, Unit B in East York, used by people coming from the Danforth, Woodbine, and Don Mills. Hours run daily from 10:00 AM to 2:30 AM. Nic vapes are the nicotine vapour products on this menu.

Nic vapes are sealed nicotine vapour items listed by brand, flavour notes, and pack details. Formats change with the page. Check the live menu for current formats instead of assuming a device style will be waiting. This is not the THC vape section.
Posted prices can change. Call 647-924-1664 if one nic vape listing is the reason you are heading to O'Connor Drive. Mention Unit B.
Walk in at Unit B during open hours. No appointment. Bring valid photo ID. Adults 19+ only. Ask for the nic vape section and compare labelled units in person.
The store is not open around the clock. After 2:30 AM the door stays closed until 10:00 AM. Give yourself time to read labels before closing.
If you are coming from the Danforth with one nic vape name, keep that name from the O'Connor Smoke page. A listing from another shop is not a hold at Unit B.
If you also want flower or a THC vape, say so after the nic vape section so staff can change pages with you. Hours still end at 2:30 AM.
East York is the neighbourhood. O'Connor Drive, Unit B, is the door.

flowerTiers.heading: Flower Tiers
paragraphs: O'Connor Smoke Cannabis is the East York shop at 132 O'Connor Dr, Unit B, open daily from 10:00 AM to 2:30 AM for the Danforth, Woodbine, and Don Mills sides of the neighbourhood. Flower tiers are the dried-cannabis groups on the live menu.

Flower is dried cannabis listed by name, weight, and posted price. Each tier is a group of those listings. Start on the flower pages, then confirm the same names at Unit B. That is a different job from choosing an edible pack or a concentrate.
Posted prices can change. Do not plan the trip around an old tier list. Call 647-924-1664 if one jar name is why you are coming to O'Connor Drive.
Walk in at Unit B while the store is open. Bring government-issued photo ID. You must be 19 or older. Staff can open the tier you reviewed and help you match labelled jars to the current page.
Check the clock before you leave Woodbine or Don Mills. Closing is 2:30 AM.
If you are comparing more than one tier, stay with the O'Connor Smoke pages. Ask staff to put the labelled jar next to the live-menu line so the name and weight are clear before you pay.
Unit B on O'Connor Drive is the counter for this list.
Review the page title before visiting so the counter request stays tied to the correct Weed tier.
